text:
Situation: Corvale East has 76 tablets of linezolid 600 mg (NDC 67877041920, Ascend Laboratories label, SPL set 7402aa01) with 5.3 days on hand. Corvale General has 387 tablets of the same product with 24 days on hand. The SPL set identifies Alkem Laboratories Limited (FEI 3006370524) as the registered manufacturing plant.

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show linezolid is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. FDA inspection history for the Alkem plant shows VAI classifications in 2011, 2013, 2016, and 2018 with no OAI or recent NAI posted.

Our position: Supply at Corvale East is critically low. Corvale General holds sufficient stock to support a transfer without dropping below two weeks of supply. No national shortage is declared. Alternative manufacturers are not on the FDA shortage list and their labels do not identify plants we can verify.

Recommended actions:
1. Execute ranked transfer option 1: move 127 tablets from Corvale General to Corvale East. Approval required: Pharmacy Director (transfer request).
2. Monitor daily usage at both sites and re-evaluate in seven days. Approval required: Pharmacy Director.

Not recommended: Purchasing from Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc., Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited, Camber Pharmaceuticals Inc., or Chartwell RX LLC at this time due to lack of plant visibility and no FDA shortage listing to support emergency procurement.
